tempMail.desc: Instant disposable email addresses to bypass spam and tracking. Reads inbox in real-time.

qrCode.desc: Custom QR code generator for WiFi, URLs, and vCards with vector SVG and high-res PNG export.

jsonStudio.desc: Offline JSON beautifier, minifier, validator, and real-time JWT token claim inspector.
